selection: All type-31 clinics reporting department 15 in Gangnam-gu/Seocho-gu or Jamsil-dong/Sincheon-dong in the official June 2026 snapshot. This is a fixed directory cohort, not all current providers or a disease prevalence survey.
notes: Reporting urology is not a specialist qualification.
No-record is not evidence that a condition is not treated.
Name mismatches and unverified records are excluded from condition comparisons.
Existing pilot profile records outside the expanded cohort are retained but do not enter the new comparisons.
